conventions.notes: Task prompts name only an item ID. Items live in the internal tracker: an opaque store (.tracker/cache.bin) that only scripts/wi-lookup reads. The README mentions only the internal tracker.
The lookup output lists the files to change under 'Files:' (the `files` field with --json). Registry items list the CSV and the module that reads it, never the generated file.

tests/__init__.py aborts unless TALLY_ENV=test, which only `make check` sets. Plain unittest fails at once; `TALLY_ENV=test python3 -m unittest` would work (an environment fix). The working command is declared in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: RuntimeError: TALLY_ENV is not set, run the suite with 'make check'

conventions.notes: The universal default (make test) is retired here and fails; the suite runs with make check, declared only in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: error: 'make test' is retired, the suite runs with 'make check'

conventions.notes: Lookups read tally/generated/registry.py, generated from registry/*.csv. Editing a CSV requires make gen; make check and the hidden checks fail on stale output.
conventions.signature: error: tally/generated/registry.py is out of date with registry/*.csv, run 'make gen'
